1.zh: 大流士[王]第二年八月，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：
1.en: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

1.zh: 「耶和华曾向你们列祖大大发怒。
1.en: “The LORD was very displeased with your fathers.

1.zh: 所以你要对以色列人说，万军之耶和华如此说：你们要转向我，我就转向你们。这是万军之耶和华说的。
1.en: Therefore tell them, the LORD of Armies says: ‘Return to me,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will return to you,’ says the LORD of Armies.

1.zh: 不要效法你们列祖。从前的先知呼叫他们说，万军之耶和华如此说：『你们要回头离开你们的恶道恶行。』他们却不听，也不顺从我。这是耶和华说的。
1.en: Don’t you be like your fathers, to whom the former prophets proclaimed, saying: The LORD of Armies says, ‘Return now from your evil ways and from your evil doings;’ but they didn’t hear nor listen to me, says the LORD.

1.zh: 你们的列祖在哪里呢？那些先知能永远存活吗？
1.en: Your fathers, where are they? And the prophets, do they live forever?

1.zh: 只是我的言语和律例，就是所吩咐我仆人众先知的，岂不临到你们列祖吗？他们就回头，说：『万军之耶和华定意按我们的行动作为向我们怎样行，他已照样行了。』」
1.en: But my words and my decrees, which I commanded my servants the prophets, didn’t they overtake your fathers? “Then they repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Armies determined to do to us, according to our ways and according to our practices, so he has dealt with us.’”

1.zh: 大流士第二年十一月，就是细罢特月二十四日，耶和华的话临到易多的孙子、比利家的儿子先知撒迦利亚，说：
1.en: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the LORD’s word came to the prophet Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, saying,

1.zh: 「我夜间观看，见一人骑着红马，站在洼地番石榴树中间。在他身后又有红马、黄马，和白马。」
1.en: “I had a vision in the night, and behold, a man riding on a red horse, and he stood among the myrtle trees that were in a ravine; and behind him there were red, brown, and white horses.

1.zh: 我对与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」他说：「我要指示你这是什么意思。」
1.en: Then I asked, ‘My lord, what are these?’” The angel who talked with me said to me, “I will show you what these are.”

1.zh: 那站在番石榴树中间的人说：「这是奉耶和华差遣在遍地走来走去的。」
1.en: The man who stood among the myrtle trees answered, “They are the ones the LORD has sent to go back and forth through the earth.”

1.zh: 那些骑马的对站在番石榴树中间耶和华的使者说：「我们已在遍地走来走去，见全地都安息平静。」
1.en: They reported to the LORD’s angel who stood among the myrtle trees, and said, “We have walked back and forth through the earth, and behold, all the earth is at rest and in peace.”

1.zh: 于是，耶和华的使者说：「万军之耶和华啊，你恼恨耶路撒冷和犹大的城邑已经七十年，你不施怜悯要到几时呢？」
1.en: Then the LORD’s angel replied, “O LORD of Armies, how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem and on the cities of Judah, against which you have had indignation these seventy years?”

1.zh: 耶和华就用美善的安慰话回答那与我说话的天使。
1.en: The LORD answered the angel who talked with me with kind and comforting words.

1.zh: 与我说话的天使对我说：「你要宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我为耶路撒冷为锡安，心里极其火热。
1.en: So the angel who talked with me said to me, “Proclaim, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great jealousy.

1.zh: 我甚恼怒那安逸的列国，因我从前稍微恼怒[我民]，他们就加害过分。
1.en: I am very angry with the nations that are at ease; for I was but a little displeased, but they added to the calamity.”

1.zh: 所以耶和华如此说：现今我回到耶路撒冷，仍施怜悯，我的殿必重建在其中，准绳必拉在耶路撒冷之上。这是万军之耶和华说的。
1.en: Therefore the LORD says: “I have returned to Jerusalem with mercy. My house shall be built in it,” says the LORD of Armies, “and a line shall be stretched out over Jerusalem.”’

1.zh: 你要再宣告说，万军之耶和华如此说：我的城邑必再丰盛发达。耶和华必再安慰锡安，拣选耶路撒冷。」
1.en: “Proclaim further, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says: “My cities will again overflow with prosperity, and the LORD will again comfort Zion, and will again choose Jerusalem.”’”

1.zh: 我举目观看，见有四角。
1.en: I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, four horns.

1.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说：「这是什么意思？」他回答说：「这是打散犹大、以色列，和耶路撒冷的角。」
1.en: I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these?” He answered me, “These are the horns which have scattered Judah, Israel, and Jerusalem.”

1.zh: 耶和华又指四个匠人给我看。
1.en: The LORD showed me four craftsmen.

1.zh: 我说：「他们来做什么呢？」他说：「这是打散犹大的角，使人不敢抬头；但这些匠人来威吓列国，打掉他们的角，就是举起打散犹大地的角。」
1.en: Then I asked, “What are these coming to do?” He said, “These are the horns which scattered Judah, so that no man lifted up his head; but these have come to terrify them, to cast down the horns of the nations that lifted up their horn against the land of Judah to scatter it.”

2.zh: 我又举目观看，见一人手拿准绳。
2.en: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.

2.zh: 我说：「你往哪里去？」他对我说：「要去量耶路撒冷，看有多宽多长。」
2.en: Then I asked, “Where are you going?” He said to me, “To measure Jerusalem, to see what is its width and what is its length.”

2.zh: 与我说话的天使去的时候，又有一位天使迎着他来，
2.en: Behold, the angel who talked with me went out, and another angel went out to meet him,

2.zh: 对他说：「你跑去告诉那少年人说，耶路撒冷必有人居住，好像无城墙的乡村，因为人民和牲畜甚多。
2.en: and said to him, “Run, speak to this young man, saying, ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.

2.zh: 耶和华说：我要作耶路撒冷四围的火城，并要作其中的荣耀。」
2.en: For I,’ says the LORD, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the middle of her.

2.zh: 耶和华说：「我从前分散你们在天的四方，现在你们要从北方之地逃回。这是耶和华说的。
2.en: Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,’ says the LORD; ‘for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,’ says the LORD.

2.zh: 与巴比伦人同住的锡安民哪，应当逃脱。
2.en: ‘Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.’

2.zh: 万军之耶和华说，在显出荣耀之后，差遣我去[惩罚]那掳掠你们的列国，摸你们的就是摸他眼中的瞳人。
2.en: For the LORD of Armies says: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.

2.zh: 看哪，我要向他们抡手，他们就必作服事他们之人的掳物，你们便知道万军之耶和华差遣我了。
2.en: For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a plunder to those who served them; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me.

2.zh: 锡安城啊，应当欢乐歌唱，因为我来要住在你中间。这是耶和华说的。」
2.en: Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion! For behold, I come and I will dwell within you,’ says the LORD.

2.zh: 那时，必有许多国归附耶和华，作他的子民。他要住在你中间，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你那里去了。
2.en: Many nations shall join themselves to the LORD in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell among you, and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

2.zh: 耶和华必收回犹大作他圣地的分，也必再拣选耶路撒冷。
2.en: The LORD will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.

2.zh: 凡有血气的都当在耶和华面前静默无声；因为他兴起，从圣所出来了。
2.en: Be silent, all flesh, before the LORD; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!”

3.zh: 天使又指给我看：大祭司约书亚站在耶和华的使者面前；撒但也站在约书亚的右边，与他作对。
3.en: He showed me Joshua the high priest standing before the LORD’s angel, and Satan standing at his right hand to be his adversary.

3.zh: 耶和华向撒但说：「撒但哪，耶和华责备你！就是拣选耶路撒冷的耶和华责备你！这不是从火中抽出来的一根柴吗？」
3.en: The LORD said to Satan, “The LORD rebuke you, Satan! Yes, the LORD who has chosen Jerusalem rebuke you! Isn’t this a burning stick plucked out of the fire?”

3.zh: 约书亚穿着污秽的衣服站在使者面前。
3.en: Now Joshua was clothed with filthy garments, and was standing before the angel.

3.zh: 使者吩咐站在面前的说：「你们要脱去他污秽的衣服」；又对约书亚说：「我使你脱离罪孽，要给你穿上华美的衣服。」
3.en: He answered and spoke to those who stood before him, saying, “Take the filthy garments off him.” To him he said, “Behold, I have caused your iniquity to pass from you, and I will clothe you with rich clothing.”

3.zh: 我说：「要将洁净的冠冕戴在他头上。」他们就把洁净的冠冕戴在他头上，给他穿上[华美的]衣服，耶和华的使者在旁边站立。
3.en: I said, “Let them set a clean turban on his head.” So they set a clean turban on his head, and clothed him; and the LORD’s angel was standing by.

3.zh: 耶和华的使者告诫约书亚说：
3.en: The LORD’s angel solemnly assured Joshua, saying,

3.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：你若遵行我的道，谨守我的命令，你就可以管理我的家，看守我的院宇；我也要使你在这些站立的人中间来往。
3.en: “The LORD of Armies says: ‘If you will walk in my ways, and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall judge my house, and shall also keep my courts, and I will give you a place of access among these who stand by.

3.zh: 大祭司约书亚啊，你和坐在你面前的同伴都当听。（他们是作预兆的。）我必使我仆人[大卫]的苗裔发出。
3.en: Hear now, Joshua the high priest, you and your fellows who sit before you, for they are men who are a sign; for, behold, I will bring out my servant, the Branch.

3.zh: 看哪，我在约书亚面前所立的石头，在一块石头上有七眼。万军之耶和华说：我要亲自雕刻这石头，并要在一日之间除掉这地的罪孽。
3.en: For, behold, the stone that I have set before Joshua: on one stone are seven eyes; behold, I will engrave its inscription,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘and I will remove the iniquity of that land in one day.

3.zh: 当那日，你们各人要请邻舍坐在葡萄树和无花果树下。这是万军之耶和华说的。」
3.en: In that day,’ says the LORD of Armies, ‘you will invite every man his neighbor under the vine and under the fig tree.’”

4.zh: 那与我说话的天使又来叫醒我，好像人睡觉被唤醒一样。
4.en: The angel who talked with me came again and wakened me, as a man who is wakened out of his sleep.

4.zh: 他问我说：「你看见了什么？」我说：「我看见了一个纯金的灯台，顶上有灯盏，灯台上有七盏灯，每盏有七个管子。
4.en: He said to me, “What do you see?” I said, “I have seen, and behold, a lamp stand all of gold, with its bowl on the top of it, and its seven lamps on it; there are seven pipes to each of the lamps which are on the top of it;

4.zh: 旁边有两棵橄榄树，一棵在灯盏的右边，一棵在灯盏的左边。」
4.en: and two olive trees by it, one on the right side of the bowl, and the other on the left side of it.”

4.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」
4.en: I answered and spoke to the angel who talked with me, saying, “What are these, my lord?”

4.zh: 与我说话的天使回答我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」
4.en: Then the angel who talked with me answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

4.zh: 他对我说：「这是耶和华指示所罗巴伯的。万军之耶和华说：不是倚靠势力，不是倚靠才能，乃是倚靠我的灵[方能成事]。
4.en: Then he answered and spoke to me, saying, “This is the LORD’s word to Zerubbabel, saying, ‘Not by might, nor by power, but by my Spirit,’ says the LORD of Armies.

4.zh: 大山哪，你算什么呢？在所罗巴伯面前，你必成为平地。他必搬出一块石头，安在[殿]顶上。人且大声欢呼说：『愿恩惠恩惠归与这殿！』」
4.en: Who are you, great mountain? Before Zerubbabel you are a plain; and he will bring out the capstone with shouts of ‘Grace, grace, to it!’”

4.zh: 耶和华的话又临到我说：
4.en: Moreover the LORD’s word came to me, saying,

4.zh: 「所罗巴伯的手立了这殿的根基，他的手也必完成这工，你就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来了。
4.en: “The hands of Zerubbabel have laid the foundation of this house. His hands shall also finish it; and you will know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you.

4.zh: 谁藐视这日的事为小呢？这七[眼]乃是耶和华的眼睛，遍察全地，见所罗巴伯手拿线铊就欢喜。」
4.en: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are the LORD’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

4.zh: 我又问天使说：「这灯台左右的两棵橄榄树是什么意思？」
4.en: Then I asked him, “What are these two olive trees on the right side of the lamp stand and on the left side of it?”

4.zh: 我二次问他说：「这两根橄榄枝在两个流出金色[油]的金嘴旁边是什么意思？」
4.en: I asked him the second time, “What are these two olive branches, which are beside the two golden spouts that pour the golden oil out of themselves?”

4.zh: 他对我说：「你不知道这是什么意思吗？」我说：「主啊，我不知道。」
4.en: He answered me, “Don’t you know what these are?” I said, “No, my lord.”

4.zh: 他说：「这是两个受膏者站在普天下主的旁边。」
4.en: Then he said, “These are the two anointed ones who stand by the Lord of the whole earth.”

5.zh: 我又举目观看，见有一飞行的书卷。
5.en: Then again I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, a flying scroll.

5.zh: 他问我说：「你看见什么？」我回答说：「我看见一飞行的书卷，长二十肘，宽十肘。」
5.en: He said to me, “What do you see?” I answered, “I see a flying scroll; its length is twenty cubits, and its width ten cubits.”

5.zh: 他对我说：「这是发出行在遍地上的咒诅。凡偷窃的必按卷上这面的话除灭；凡起[假]誓的必按卷上那面的话除灭。
5.en: Then he said to me, “This is the curse that goes out over the surface of the whole land, for everyone who steals shall be cut off according to it on the one side; and everyone who swears falsely shall be cut off according to it on the other side.

5.zh: 万军之耶和华说：我必使这书卷出去，进入偷窃人的家和指我名起假誓人的家，必常在他家里，连房屋带木石都毁灭了。」
5.en: I will cause it to go out,” says the LORD of Armies, “and it will enter into the house of the thief, and into the house of him who swears falsely by my name; and it will remain in the middle of his house, and will destroy it with its timber and its stones.”

5.zh: 与我说话的天使出来，对我说：「你要举目观看，见所出来的是什么？」
5.en: Then the angel who talked with me came forward and said to me, “Lift up now your eyes and see what this is that is appearing.”

5.zh: 我说：「这是什么呢？」他说：「这出来的是量器。」他又说：「这是恶人在遍地的形状。」
5.en: I said, “What is it?” He said, “This is the ephah basket that is appearing.” He said moreover, “This is their appearance in all the land—

5.zh: （我见有一片圆铅被举起来。）这坐在量器中的是个妇人。
5.en: and behold, a lead cover weighing one talent was lifted up—and there was a woman sitting in the middle of the ephah basket.”

5.zh: 天使说：「这是罪恶。」他就把妇人扔在量器中，将那片圆铅扔在量器的口上。
5.en: He said, “This is Wickedness;” and he threw her down into the middle of the ephah basket; and he threw the lead weight on its mouth.

5.zh: 我又举目观看，见有两个妇人出来，在她们翅膀中有风，[飞得甚快]，翅膀如同鹳鸟的翅膀。她们将量器抬起来，悬在天地中间。
5.en: Then I lifted up my eyes and saw, and behold, there were two women; and the wind was in their wings. Now they had wings like the wings of a stork, and they lifted up the ephah basket between earth and the sky.

5.zh: 我问与我说话的天使说：「她们要将量器抬到哪里去呢？」
5.en: Then I said to the angel who talked with me, “Where are these carrying the ephah basket?”

5.zh: 他对我说：「要往示拿地去，为它盖造房屋；等房屋齐备，就把它安置在自己的地方。」
5.en: He said to me, “To build her a house in the land of Shinar. When it is prepared, she will be set there in her own place.”

6.zh: 我又举目观看，见有四辆车从两山中间出来；那山是铜山。
6.en: Again I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, four chariots came out from between two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of bronze.

6.zh: 第一辆车套着红马，第二辆车套着黑马。
6.en: In the first chariot were red horses. In the second chariot were black horses.

6.zh: 第三辆车套着白马，第四辆车套着有斑点的壮马。
6.en: In the third chariot were white horses. In the fourth chariot were dappled horses, all of them powerful.

6.zh: 我就问与我说话的天使说：「主啊，这是什么意思？」
6.en: Then I asked the angel who talked with me, “What are these, my lord?”

6.zh: 天使回答我说：「这是天的四风，是从普天下的主面前出来的。」
6.en: The angel answered me, “These are the four winds of the sky, which go out from standing before the Lord of all the earth.

6.zh: 套着黑马的[车]往北方去，白马跟随在后；有斑点的马往南方去。
6.en: The one with the black horses goes out toward the north country; and the white went out after them; and the dappled went out toward the south country.”

6.zh: 壮马出来，要在遍地走来走去。天使说：「你们只管在遍地走来走去。」它们就照样行了。
6.en: The strong went out, and sought to go that they might walk back and forth through the earth. He said, “Go around and through the earth!” So they walked back and forth through the earth.

6.zh: 他又呼叫我说：「看哪，往北方去的已在北方安慰我的心。」
6.en: Then he called to me, and spoke to me, saying, “Behold, those who go toward the north country have quieted my spirit in the north country.”
The LORD’s word came to me, saying,

6.zh: 「你要从被掳之人中取黑玳、多比雅、耶大雅的[金银]。这三人是从巴比伦来到西番雅的儿子约西亚的家里。当日你要进他的家，
6.en: “Take of them of the captivity, even of Heldai, of Tobijah, and of Jedaiah; and come the same day, and go into the house of Josiah the son of Zephaniah, where they have come from Babylon.

6.zh: 取这金银做冠冕，戴在约撒答的儿子大祭司约书亚的头上，
6.en: Yes, take silver and gold, and make crowns, and set them on the head of Joshua the son of Jehozadak, the high priest;

6.zh: 对他说，万军之耶和华如此说：看哪，那名称为大卫苗裔的，他要在本处长起来，并要建造耶和华的殿。
6.en: and speak to him, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “Behold, the man whose name is the Branch! He will grow up out of his place; and he will build the LORD’s temple.

6.zh: 他要建造耶和华的殿，并担负尊荣，坐在位上掌王权；又必在位上作祭司，使两职之间筹定和平。
6.en: He will build the LORD’s temple. He will bear the glory, and will sit and rule on his throne. He will be a priest on his throne. The counsel of peace will be between them both.

6.zh: 这冠冕要归希连、多比雅、耶大雅，和西番雅的儿子贤，放在耶和华的殿里为记念。」
6.en: The crowns shall be to Helem, to Tobijah, to Jedaiah, and to Hen the son of Zephaniah, for a memorial in the LORD’s temple.

6.zh: 远方的人也要来建造耶和华的殿，你们就知道万军之耶和华差遣我到你们这里来。你们若留意听从耶和华—你们　神的话，[这事]必然成就。
6.en: Those who are far off shall come and build in the LORD’s temple; and you shall know that the LORD of Armies has sent me to you. This will happen, if you will diligently obey the LORD your God’s voice.”’”

7.zh: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。
7.en: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

7.zh: 那时伯特利人已经打发沙利色和利坚米勒，并跟从他们的人，去恳求耶和华的恩，
7.en: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,

7.zh: 并问万军之耶和华殿中的祭司和先知说：「我历年以来，在五月间哭泣斋戒，现在还当这样行吗？」
7.en: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

7.zh: 万军之耶和华的话就临到我说：
7.en: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,

7.zh: 「你要宣告国内的众民和祭司，说：『你们这七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，岂是丝毫向我禁食吗？
7.en: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

7.zh: 你们吃喝，不是为自己吃，为自己喝吗？
7.en: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

7.zh: 当耶路撒冷和四围的城邑有居民，正兴盛，南地高原有人居住的时候，耶和华借从前的先知所宣告的话，你们不[当听]吗？』」
7.en: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

7.zh: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说：
7.en: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

7.zh: 「万军之耶和华曾对[你们的列祖]如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。
7.en: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

7.zh: 不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」
7.en: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

7.zh: 他们却不肯听从，扭转肩头，塞耳不听，
7.en: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

7.zh: 使心硬如金钢石，不听律法和万军之耶和华用灵借从前的先知所说的话。故此，万军之耶和华大发烈怒。
7.en: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.

7.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；将来他们呼求我，我也不听！
7.en: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;

7.zh: 我必以旋风吹散他们到素不认识的万国中。这样，他们的地就荒凉，甚至无人来往经过，因为他们使美好之地荒凉了。」
7.en: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
8.en: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.

8.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：我为锡安心里极其火热，我为她火热，向[她的仇敌]发烈怒。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “I am jealous for Zion with great jealousy, and I am jealous for her with great wrath.”

8.zh: 耶和华如此说：我现在回到锡安，要住在耶路撒冷中。耶路撒冷必称为诚实的城，万军之耶和华的山必称为圣山。
8.en: The LORD says: “I have returned to Zion, and will dwell in the middle of Jerusalem. Jerusalem shall be called ‘The City of Truth;’ and the mountain of the LORD of Armies, ‘The Holy Mountain.’”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：将来必有年老的男女坐在耶路撒冷街上，因为年纪老迈就手拿拐杖。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “Old men and old women will again dwell in the streets of Jerusalem, every man with his staff in his hand because of their old age.

8.zh: 城中街上必满有男孩女孩玩耍。
8.en: The streets of the city will be full of boys and girls playing in its streets.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：到那日，这事在余剩的民眼中看为希奇，在我眼中也看为希奇吗？这是万军之耶和华说的。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “If it is marvelous in the eyes of the remnant of this people in those days, should it also be marvelous in my eyes?” says the LORD of Armies.

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：我要从东方从西方救回我的民。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “Behold, I will save my people from the east country and from the west country.

8.zh: 我要领他们来，使他们住在耶路撒冷中。他们要作我的子民，我要作他们的　神，都凭诚实和公义。」
8.en: I will bring them, and they will dwell within Jerusalem. They will be my people, and I will be their God, in truth and in righteousness.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「当建造万军之耶和华的殿，立根基之日的先知所说的话，现在你们听见，应当手里强壮。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “Let your hands be strong, you who hear in these days these words from the mouth of the prophets who were in the day that the foundation of the house of the LORD of Armies was laid, even the temple, that it might be built.

8.zh: 那日以先，人得不着雇价，牲畜也是如此；且因敌人的缘故，出入之人不得平安，乃因我使众人互相攻击。
8.en: For before those days there was no wages for man nor any wages for an animal, neither was there any peace to him who went out or came in, because of the adversary. For I set all men everyone against his neighbor.

8.zh: 但如今，我待这余剩的民必不像从前。这是万军之耶和华说的。
8.en: But now I will not be to the remnant of this people as in the former days,” says the LORD of Armies.

8.zh: 因为他们必平安撒种，葡萄树必结果子，地土必有出产，天也必降甘露。我要使这余剩的民享受这一切的福。
8.en: “For the seed of peace and the vine will yield its fruit, and the ground will give its increase, and the heavens will give their dew. I will cause the remnant of this people to inherit all these things.

8.zh: 犹大家和以色列家啊，你们从前在列国中怎样成为可咒诅的；照样，我要拯救你们，使人称你们为有福的。你们不要惧怕，手要强壮。」
8.en: It shall come to pass that, as you were a curse among the nations, house of Judah and house of Israel, so I will save you, and you shall be a blessing. Don’t be afraid. Let your hands be strong.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「你们列祖惹我发怒的时候，我怎样定意降祸，并不后悔。
8.en: For the LORD of Armies says: “As I thought to do evil to you when your fathers provoked me to wrath,” says the LORD of Armies, “and I didn’t repent,

8.zh: 现在我照样定意施恩与耶路撒冷和犹大家，你们不要惧怕。
8.en: so again I have thought in these days to do good to Jerusalem and to the house of Judah. Don’t be afraid.

8.zh: 你们所当行的是这样：各人与邻舍说话诚实，在城门口按至理判断，使人和睦。
8.en: These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and peace in your gates,

8.zh: 谁都不可心里谋害邻舍，也不可喜爱起假誓，因为这些事都为我所恨恶。这是耶和华说的。」
8.en: and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath; for all these are things that I hate,” says the LORD.

8.zh: 万军之耶和华的话临到我说：
8.en: The word of the LORD of Armies came to me.

8.zh: 「万军之耶和华如此说：四月、五月禁食的日子，七月、十月禁食的日子，必变为犹大家欢喜快乐的日子和欢乐的节期；所以你们要喜爱诚实与和平。」
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “The fasts of the fourth, fifth, seventh, and tenth months shall be for the house of Judah joy, gladness, and cheerful feasts. Therefore love truth and peace.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：「将来必有列国的人和多城的居民来到。
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “Many peoples and the inhabitants of many cities will yet come.

8.zh: 这城的居民必到那城，说：『我们要快去恳求耶和华的恩，寻求万军之耶和华；我也要去。』
8.en: The inhabitants of one will go to another, saying, ‘Let’s go speedily to entreat the favor of the LORD, and to seek the LORD of Armies. I will go also.’

8.zh: 必有列邦的人和强国的民来到耶路撒冷寻求万军之耶和华，恳求耶和华的恩。
8.en: Yes, many peoples and strong nations will come to seek the LORD of Armies in Jerusalem and to entreat the favor of the LORD.”

8.zh: 万军之耶和华如此说：在那些日子，必有十个人从列国诸族中出来，拉住一个犹大人的衣襟，说：『我们要与你们同去，因为我们听见　神与你们同在了。』」
8.en: The LORD of Armies says: “In those days, ten men out of all the languages of the nations will take hold of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, ‘We will go with you, for we have heard that God is with you.’”

9.zh: 耶和华的默示应验在哈得拉地大马士革 —世人和以色列各支派的眼目都仰望耶和华—
9.en: A revelation. The LORD’s word is against the land of Hadrach, and will rest upon Damascus— for the eye of man and of all the tribes of Israel is toward the LORD—

9.zh: 和靠近的哈马，并泰尔、西顿； 因为这二城的人大有智慧。
9.en: and Hamath, also, which borders on it, Tyre and Sidon, because they are very wise.

9.zh: 泰尔为自己修筑保障， 积蓄银子如尘沙， 堆起精金如街上的泥土。
9.en: Tyre built herself a stronghold, and heaped up silver like the dust, and fine gold like the mire of the streets.

9.zh: 主必赶出她， 打败她海上的权利； 她必被火烧灭。
9.en: Behold, the Lord will dispossess her, and he will strike her power in the sea; and she will be devoured with fire.

9.zh: 亚实基伦看见必惧怕； 迦萨看见甚痛苦； 以革伦因失了盼望蒙羞。 迦萨必不再有君王； 亚实基伦也不再有居民。
9.en: Ashkelon will see it, and fear; Gaza also, and will writhe in agony; as will Ekron, for her expectation will be disappointed; and the king will perish from Gaza, and Ashkelon will not be inhabited.

9.zh: 私生子必住在亚实突； 我必除灭非利士人的骄傲。
9.en: Foreigners will dwell in Ashdod, and I will cut off the pride of the Philistines.

9.zh: 我必除去他口中带血之肉 和牙齿内可憎之物。 他必作为余剩的人归与我们的　神， 必在犹大像族长； 以革伦人必如耶布斯人。
9.en: I will take away his blood out of his mouth, and his abominations from between his teeth; and he also will be a remnant for our God; and he will be as a chieftain in Judah, and Ekron as a Jebusite.

9.zh: 我必在我家的四围安营， 使敌军不得任意往来， 暴虐的人也不再经过， 因为我亲眼看顾[我的家]。
9.en: I will encamp around my house against the army, that no one pass through or return; and no oppressor will pass through them any more: for now I have seen with my eyes.

9.zh: 锡安的民哪，应当大大喜乐； 耶路撒冷的民哪，应当欢呼。 看哪，你的王来到你这里！ 他是公义的，并且施行拯救， 谦谦和和地骑着驴， 就是骑着驴的驹子。
9.en: Rejoice greatly, daughter of Zion! Shout, daughter of Jerusalem! Behold, your King comes to you! He is righteous, and having salvation; lowly, and riding on a donkey, even on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

9.zh: 我必除灭以法莲的战车 和耶路撒冷的战马； 争战的弓也必除灭。 他必向列国讲和平； 他的权柄必从这海管到那海， 从大河管到地极。
9.en: I will cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem. The battle bow will be cut off; and he will speak peace to the nations. His dominion will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.

9.zh: 锡安哪，我因与你立约的血， 将你中间被掳而囚的人从无水的坑中释放出来。
9.en: As for you also, because of the blood of your covenant, I have set free your prisoners from the pit in which is no water.

9.zh: 你们被囚而有指望的人都要转回保障。 我今日说明，我必加倍赐福给你们。
9.en: Turn to the stronghold, you prisoners of hope! Even today I declare that I will restore double to you.

9.zh: 我拿犹大作上弦的弓； 我拿以法莲为张弓的箭。 锡安哪，我要激发你的众子， 攻击希腊的众子，使你如勇士的刀。
9.en: For indeed I bend Judah as a bow for me. I have loaded the bow with Ephraim. I will stir up your sons, Zion, against your sons, Greece, and will make you like the sword of a mighty man.

9.zh: 耶和华必显现在他们以上； 他的箭必射出像闪电。 主耶和华必吹角， 乘南方的旋风而行。
9.en: The LORD will be seen over them. His arrow will flash like lightning. The Lord GOD will blow the trumpet, and will go with whirlwinds of the south.

9.zh: 万军之耶和华必保护他们； 他们必吞灭[仇敌]，践踏弹石。 他们必喝[血]呐喊，犹如饮酒； 他们必像盛满[血]的碗， 又像坛的四角满了[血]。
9.en: The LORD of Armies will defend them. They will destroy and overcome with sling stones. They will drink, and roar as through wine. They will be filled like bowls, like the corners of the altar.

9.zh: 当那日，耶和华—他们的　神 必看他的民如群羊，拯救他们； 因为[他们必像]冠冕上的宝石， 高举在他的地以上。
9.en: The LORD their God will save them in that day as the flock of his people; for they are like the jewels of a crown, lifted on high over his land.

9.zh: 他的恩慈何等大！ 他的荣美何其盛！ 五谷健壮少男； 新酒培养处女。
9.en: For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the virgins.

10.zh: 当春雨的时候， 你们要向发闪电的耶和华求雨。 他必为众人降下甘霖， 使田园生长菜蔬。
10.en: Ask of the LORD rain in the spring time, the LORD who makes storm clouds, and he gives rain showers to everyone for the plants in the field.

10.zh: 因为，家神所言的是虚空； 卜士所见的是虚假； 做梦者所说的是假梦。 他们白白地安慰人， 所以众人如羊流离， 因无牧人就受苦。
10.en: For the teraphim have spoken vanity, and the diviners have seen a lie; and they have told false dreams. They comfort in vain. Therefore they go their way like sheep. They are oppressed, because there is no shepherd.

10.zh: 我的怒气向牧人发作； 我必惩罚公山羊； 因我—万军之耶和华 眷顾自己的羊群，就是[犹大]家， 必使他们如骏马在阵上。
10.en: My anger is kindled against the shepherds, and I will punish the male goats, for the LORD of Armies has visited his flock, the house of Judah, and will make them as his majestic horse in the battle.

10.zh: 房角石、钉子、争战的弓， 和一切掌权的都从他而出。
10.en: From him will come the cornerstone, from him the tent peg, from him the battle bow, from him every ruler together.

10.zh: 他们必如勇士在阵上 将[仇敌]践踏在街上的泥土中。 他们必争战，因为耶和华与他们同在； 骑马的也必羞愧。
10.en: They will be as mighty men, treading down muddy streets in the battle. They will fight, because the LORD is with them. The riders on horses will be confounded.

10.zh: 我要坚固犹大家，拯救约瑟家， 要领他们归回。 我要怜恤他们； 他们必像未曾弃绝的一样， 都因我是耶和华—他们的　神， 我必应允他们[的祷告]。
10.en: “I will strengthen the house of Judah, and I will save the house of Joseph. I will bring them back, for I have mercy on them. They will be as though I had not cast them off, for I am the LORD their God, and I will hear them.

10.zh: 以法莲人必如勇士； 他们心中畅快如同喝酒； 他们的儿女必看见而快活； 他们的心必因耶和华喜乐。
10.en: Ephraim will be like a mighty man, and their heart will rejoice as through wine. Yes, their children will see it and rejoice. Their heart will be glad in the LORD.

10.zh: 我要发嘶声，聚集他们， 因我已经救赎他们。 他们的人数必加增， 如从前加增一样。
10.en: I will signal for them and gather them, for I have redeemed them. They will increase as they were before.

10.zh: 我虽然播散他们在列国中， 他们必在远方记念我。 他们与儿女都必存活，且得归回。
10.en: I will sow them among the peoples. They will remember me in far countries. They will live with their children and will return.

10.zh: 我必再领他们出埃及地， 招聚他们出亚述， 领他们到基列和黎巴嫩； 这地尚且不够他们居住。
10.en: I will bring them again also out of the land of Egypt, and gather them out of Assyria. I will bring them into the land of Gilead and Lebanon; and there won’t be room enough for them.

10.zh: 耶和华必经过苦海，击打海浪， 使尼罗河的深处都枯干。 亚述的骄傲必致卑微； 埃及的权柄必然灭没。
10.en: He will pass through the sea of affliction, and will strike the waves in the sea, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up; and the pride of Assyria will be brought down, and the scepter of Egypt will depart.

10.zh: 我必使他们倚靠我，得以坚固； 一举一动必奉我的名。 这是耶和华说的。
10.en: I will strengthen them in the LORD. They will walk up and down in his name,” says the LORD.

11.zh: 黎巴嫩哪，开开你的门， 任火烧灭你的香柏树。
11.en: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.

11.zh: 松树啊，应当哀号； 因为香柏树倾倒，佳美的树毁坏。 巴珊的橡树啊，应当哀号， 因为茂盛的树林已经倒了。
11.en: Wail, cypress tree, for the cedar has fallen, because the stately ones are destroyed. Wail, you oaks of Bashan, for the strong forest has come down.

11.zh: 听啊，有牧人哀号的声音， 因他们荣华[的草场]毁坏了。 有少壮狮子咆哮的声音， 因约旦河旁的丛林荒废了。
11.en: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds! For their glory is destroyed—a voice of the roaring of young lions! For the pride of the Jordan is ruined.

11.zh: 耶和华—我的　神如此说：「你—撒迦利亚要牧养这将宰的群羊。
11.en: The LORD my God says: “Feed the flock of slaughter.

11.zh: 买他们的宰了他们，以自己为无罪；卖他们的说：『耶和华是应当称颂的，因我成为富足。』牧养他们的并不怜恤他们。
11.en: Their buyers slaughter them and go unpunished. Those who sell them say, ‘Blessed be the LORD, for I am rich;’ and their own shepherds don’t pity them.

11.zh: 耶和华说：『我不再怜恤这地的居民，必将这民交给各人的邻舍和他们王的手中。他们必毁灭这地，我也不救这民脱离他们的手。』」
11.en: For I will no more pity the inhabitants of the land,” says the LORD; “but, behold, I will deliver every one of the men into his neighbor’s hand and into the hand of his king. They will strike the land, and out of their hand I will not deliver them.”

11.zh: 于是，我牧养这将宰的群羊，就是群中最困苦的羊。我拿着两根杖，一根我称为「荣美」，一根我称为「联索」。这样，我牧养了群羊。
11.en: So I fed the flock to be slaughtered, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called “Favor” and the other I called “Union”, and I fed the flock.

11.zh: 一月之内，我除灭三个牧人，因为我的心厌烦他们；他们的心也憎嫌我。
11.en: I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.

11.zh: 我就说：「我不牧养你们。要死的，由他死；要丧亡的，由他丧亡；余剩的，由他们彼此相食。」
11.en: Then I said, “I will not feed you. That which dies, let it die; and that which is to be cut off, let it be cut off; and let those who are left eat each other’s flesh.”

11.zh: 我折断那称为「荣美」的杖，表明我废弃与万民所立的约。
11.en: I took my staff Favor and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.

11.zh: 当日就废弃了。这样，那些仰望我的困苦羊就知道所说的是耶和华的话。
11.en: It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was the LORD’s word.

11.zh: 我对他们说：「你们若以为美，就给我工价。不然，就罢了！」于是他们给了三十块钱作为我的工价。
11.en: I said to them, “If you think it best, give me my wages; and if not, keep them.” So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.

11.zh: 耶和华吩咐我说：「要把众人所估定美好的价值丢给窑户。」我便将这三十块钱，在耶和华的殿中丢给窑户了。
11.en: The LORD said to me, “Throw it to the potter—the handsome price that I was valued at by them!” I took the thirty pieces of silver and threw them to the potter in the LORD’s house.

11.zh: 我又折断称为「联索」的那根杖，表明我废弃犹大与以色列弟兄的情谊。
11.en: Then I cut apart my other staff, Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.

11.zh: 耶和华又吩咐我说：「你再取愚昧牧人所用的器具，
11.en: The LORD said to me, “Take for yourself yet again the equipment of a foolish shepherd.

11.zh: 因我要在这地兴起一个牧人。他不看顾丧亡的，不寻找分散的，不医治受伤的，也不牧养强壮的；却要吃肥[羊]的肉，撕裂它的蹄子。
11.en: For, behold, I will raise up a shepherd in the land who will not visit those who are cut off, neither will seek those who are scattered, nor heal that which is broken, nor feed that which is sound; but he will eat the meat of the fat sheep, and will tear their hoofs in pieces.

11.zh: 无用的牧人丢弃羊群有祸了！ 刀必临到他的膀臂和右眼上。 他的膀臂必全然枯干； 他的右眼也必昏暗失明。」
11.en: Woe to the worthless shepherd who leaves the flock! The sword will strike his arm and his right eye. His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!”

12.zh: 耶和华论以色列的默示。 铺张诸天、建立地基、造人里面之灵的耶和华说：
12.en: A revelation of the LORD’s word concerning Israel: The LORD, who stretches out the heavens and lays the foundation of the earth, and forms the spirit of man within him says:

12.zh: 「我必使耶路撒冷被围困的时候，向四围列国的民成为令人昏醉的杯；这默示也论到犹大。
12.en: “Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of reeling to all the surrounding peoples, and it will also be on Judah in the siege against Jerusalem.

12.zh: 那日，我必使耶路撒冷向聚集攻击他的万民当作一块重石头；凡举起的必受重伤。
12.en: It will happen in that day that I will make Jerusalem a burdensome stone for all the peoples. All who burden themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the nations of the earth will be gathered together against it.

12.zh: 耶和华说：到那日，我必使一切马匹惊惶，使骑马的颠狂。我必看顾犹大家，使列国的一切马匹瞎眼。
12.en: In that day,” says the LORD, “I will strike every horse with terror and his rider with madness. I will open my eyes on the house of Judah, and will strike every horse of the peoples with blindness.

12.zh: 犹大的族长必心里说：『耶路撒冷的居民倚靠万军之耶和华—他们的　神，就作我们的能力。』
12.en: The chieftains of Judah will say in their heart, ‘The inhabitants of Jerusalem are my strength in the LORD of Armies their God.’

12.zh: 「那日，我必使犹大的族长如火盆在木柴中，又如火把在禾捆里；他们必左右烧灭四围列国的民。耶路撒冷人必仍住本处，就是耶路撒冷。
12.en: In that day I will make the chieftains of Judah like a pan of fire among wood, and like a flaming torch among sheaves. They will devour all the surrounding peoples on the right hand and on the left; and Jerusalem will yet again dwell in their own place, even in Jerusalem.

12.zh: 「耶和华必先拯救犹大的帐棚，免得大卫家的荣耀和耶路撒冷居民的荣耀胜过犹大。
12.en: The LORD also will save the tents of Judah first, that the glory of David’s house and the glory of the inhabitants of Jerusalem not be magnified above Judah.

12.zh: 那日，耶和华必保护耶路撒冷的居民。他们中间软弱的必如大卫；大卫的家必如　神，如行在他们前面之耶和华的使者。
12.en: In that day the LORD will defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem. He who is feeble among them at that day will be like David, and David’s house will be like God, like the LORD’s angel before them.

12.zh: 那日，我必定意灭绝来攻击耶路撒冷各国的民。
12.en: It will happen in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem.

12.zh: 「我必将那施恩叫人恳求的灵，浇灌大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民。他们必仰望我，就是他们所扎的；必为我悲哀，如丧独生子，又为我愁苦，如丧长子。
12.en: I will pour on David’s house and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of supplication. They will look to me whom they have pierced; and they shall mourn for him as one mourns for his only son, and will grieve bitterly for him as one grieves for his firstborn.

12.zh: 那日，耶路撒冷必有大大的悲哀，如米吉多平原之哈达临门的悲哀。
12.en: In that day there will be a great mourning in Jerusalem, like the mourning of Hadadrimmon in the valley of Megiddo.

12.zh: 境内一家一家地都必悲哀。大卫家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。拿单家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
12.en: The land will mourn, every family apart; the family of David’s house apart, and their wives apart; the family of the house of Nathan apart, and their wives apart;

12.zh: 利未家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。示每家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
12.en: the family of the house of Levi apart, and their wives apart; the family of the Shimeites apart, and their wives apart;

12.zh: 其余的各家，男的独在一处，女的独在一处。
12.en: all the families who remain, every family apart, and their wives apart.

13.zh: 「那日，必给大卫家和耶路撒冷的居民开一个泉源，洗除罪恶与污秽。」
13.en: “In that day there will be a fountain opened to David’s house and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, for sin and for uncleanness.

13.zh: 万军之耶和华说：「那日，我必从地上除灭偶像的名，不再被人记念；也必使这地不再有[假]先知与污秽的灵。
13.en: It will come to pass in that day, says the LORD of Armies, that I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they will be remembered no more. I will also cause the prophets and the spirit of impurity to pass out of the land.

13.zh: 若再有人说预言，生他的父母必对他说：『你不得存活，因为你托耶和华的名说假预言。』生他的父母在他说预言的时候，要将他刺透。
13.en: It will happen that when anyone still prophesies, then his father and his mother who bore him will tell him, ‘You must die, because you speak lies in the LORD’s name;’ and his father and his mother who bore him will stab him when he prophesies.

13.zh: 那日，凡作先知说预言的必因他所论的异象羞愧，不再穿毛衣哄骗人。
13.en: It will happen in that day that the prophets will each be ashamed of his vision when he prophesies; they won’t wear a hairy mantle to deceive,

13.zh: 他必说：『我不是先知，我是耕地的；我从幼年作人的奴仆。』
13.en: but he will say, ‘I am no prophet, I am a tiller of the ground; for I have been made a bondservant from my youth.’

13.zh: 必有人问他说：『你两臂中间是什么伤呢？』他必回答说：『这是我在亲友家中所受的伤。』」
13.en: One will say to him, ‘What are these wounds between your arms?’ Then he will answer, ‘Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.’

13.zh: 万军之耶和华说： 刀剑哪，应当兴起， 攻击我的牧人和我的同伴。 击打牧人，羊就分散； 我必反手加在微小者的身上。
13.en: “Awake, sword, against my shepherd, and against the man who is close to me,” says the LORD of Armies. “Strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered; and I will turn my hand against the little ones.

13.zh: 耶和华说：这全地的人， 三分之二必剪除而死， 三分之一仍必存留。
13.en: It shall happen that in all the land,” says the LORD, “two parts in it will be cut off and die; but the third will be left in it.

13.zh: 我要使这三分之一经火， 熬炼他们，如熬炼银子； 试炼他们，如试炼金子。 他们必求告我的名， 我必应允他们。 我要说：这是我的子民。 他们也要说：耶和华是我[们]的　神。
13.en: I will bring the third part into the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will test them like gold is tested. They will call on my name, and I will hear them. I will say, ‘It is my people;’ and they will say, ‘The LORD is my God.’”

14.zh: 耶和华的日子临近，你的财物必被抢掠，在你中间分散。
14.en: Behold, a day of the LORD comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.

14.zh: 因为我必聚集万国与耶路撒冷争战，城必被攻取，房屋被抢夺，妇女被玷污，城中的民一半被掳去；剩下的民仍在城中，不致剪除。
14.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.

14.zh: 那时，耶和华必出去与那些国争战，好像从前争战一样。
14.en: Then the LORD will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.

14.zh: 那日，他的脚必站在耶路撒冷前面朝东的橄榄山上。这山必从中间分裂，自东至西成为极大的谷。山的一半向北挪移，一半向南挪移。
14.en: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.

14.zh: 你们要从我山的谷中逃跑，因为山谷必延到亚萨。你们逃跑，必如犹大王乌西雅年间的人逃避大地震一样。耶和华—我的　神必降临，有一切圣者同来。
14.en: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

14.zh: 那日，必没有光，三光必退缩。
14.en: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

14.zh: 那日，必是耶和华所知道的，不是白昼，也不是黑夜，到了晚上才有光明。
14.en: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

14.zh: 那日，必有活水从耶路撒冷出来，一半往东海流，一半往西海流；冬夏都是如此。
14.en: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

14.zh: 耶和华必作全地的王。那日耶和华必为独一无二的，他的名也是独一无二的。
14.en: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.

14.zh: 全地，从迦巴直到耶路撒冷南方的临门，要变为亚拉巴。耶路撒冷必仍居高位，就是从便雅悯门到第一门之处，又到角门，并从哈楠业楼，直到王的酒榨。
14.en: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

14.zh: 人必住在其中，不再有咒诅。耶路撒冷人必安然居住。
14.en: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

14.zh: 耶和华用灾殃攻击那与耶路撒冷争战的列国人，必是这样：他们两脚站立的时候，肉必消没，眼在眶中干瘪，舌在口中溃烂。
14.en: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

14.zh: 那日，耶和华必使他们大大扰乱。他们各人彼此揪住，举手攻击。
14.en: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

14.zh: 犹大也必在耶路撒冷争战。那时四围各国的财物，就是许多金银衣服，必被收聚。
14.en: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

14.zh: 那临到马匹、骡子、骆驼、驴，和营中一切牲畜的灾殃是与那灾殃一般。
14.en: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

14.zh: 所有来攻击耶路撒冷列国中剩下的人，必年年上来敬拜[大]君王—万军之耶和华，并守住棚节。
14.en: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

14.zh: 地上[万]族中，凡不上耶路撒冷敬拜[大]君王—万军之耶和华的，必无雨降在他们的地上。
14.en: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

14.zh: 埃及族若不上来，[雨]也不降在他们的地上；凡不上来守住棚节的列国人，耶和华也必用这灾攻击他们。
14.en: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

14.zh: 这就是埃及的刑罚和那不上来守住棚节之列国的刑罚。
14.en: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

14.zh: 当那日，马的铃铛上必有「归耶和华为圣」的这句话。耶和华殿内的锅必如祭坛前的碗一样。
14.en: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

14.zh: 凡耶路撒冷和犹大的锅都必归万军之耶和华为圣。凡献祭的都必来取这锅，煮[肉]在其中。当那日，在万军之耶和华的殿中必不再有迦南人。
14.en: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.
